rules.statement: A praedial servitude can be lost by non-user for a period of one third of a century, i.e., 30 years under Roman-Dutch Law. However, this rule no longer applies in Sri Lanka due to the Prescription Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: "The effect of Ordinance No. 22 of 1871 and No. 8 of 1834 is to sweep away all the Roman-Dutch Law relating to the acquisition of immovable property by prescription except as regards property of the crown."
